note: Fayette County Conservation campground in the 1,000-acre Gilbertson Park on the Turkey River just south of Elgin, linked by a paved bike trail to the Gilbertson Nature Center (petting zoo and nature center open Wednesday-Sunday, Memorial Day to Labor Day). A separate equestrian campground has primitive sites and hitching posts. --Claude
summary: Fees added $15-20 (undated county page). Confirmed showers, flush toilets, dump. Booking, season, 30-amp and the 35-ft length are stated on no county page; left as stored. Not waterfront confirmed (pads 140 m+ from the river behind the loop and a tree belt).
flags: FEES undated: the county page posts '$20/night with electricity $15/night without electricity' with no year. The $15 base is the non-electric rate; MyCountyParks says the modern campground has 8 primitive sites besides the 7 walk-in ones, so a drive-in $15 site appears to exist, but its size is not posted.

WATERFRONT stays not waterfront: the Turkey River here is ~45-60 m wide (river-sized). The RV pads are on the east arm of the loop, about 140-160 m from the bank, with the loop road, the central lawn and a continuous tree belt along the bank in between. The ground nearest the river (west side) holds a shelter, a toilet building and an open sandy access; no pads seen there. No view earned.

BOOKING (stored FCFS, not reservable, derived from note prose): neither the county page nor MyCountyParks says how sites are taken; MyCountyParks lists no bookable campsites for the park, which fits FCFS. Left as stored.
